cases.title: Host Ready must reflect an available Direct Seed
cases.task: Diagnose and correct stale Host Ready when the Coordinator cannot see a Direct Seed. Do not mask the underlying missing seed.
acceptance: The Coordinator-visible seed and Host readiness agree.
Guest receives a clear failure instead of false Ready.
regressions: No trust bypass or synthetic project availability.
Host bridge exit revokes stale readiness.

cases.title: Verified existing Project must reopen on a short execution path
cases.task: Handle an already verified Project reopened in Unity without a path-too-long failure.
acceptance: Reuse requires matching Project UUID, baseline revision and manifest hash.
Windows Unity execution path stays short after reopening.
regressions: No unsafe bypass for malformed managed roots.

steps.reason: Windows-only execution alias coverage is not proven by skipped Linux assertions.
Physical path/reopen evidence is outside source CI.

cases.title: Verified Guest retry preserves managed root identity and safety
cases.task: Regress the previously observed false unmanaged-content refusal without disabling the Project identity fence.
acceptance: Retry distinguishes the project's own identity lock from unmanaged content.
A nested UUID Project directory is not silently accepted as root.
regressions: Path escape or unrelated unmanaged data remains rejected.
No overwrite of previously verified Active revision.

steps.reason: Real Windows Guest retry requires physical Host/Guest evidence.
